title: Tracing small-scale structure formation through cosmic time with strong gravitational lensing: A case for a next-generation sub-millimetre/millimetre interferometer
comment: Part of the ALMA2040 White Paper Series
summary: The nature of dark matter and the growth of supermassive black holes (SMBHs) remain major open questions in modern astrophysics. Both leave a key signature in an overlapping, largely unexplored mass range: $<10^7$ M$_{\odot}$ dark haloes and wandering black holes. These may be undetectable directly, but detectable through gravitational perturbation of strongly lensed images, and partly or entirely distinguishable from one another through lensing data alone. We demonstrate through realistic simulations that a 255-element sub-mm/mm interferometer could probe this critical mass regime, detecting gravitational perturbations in strongly lensed dusty star-forming galaxies (DSFGs) from objects down to at least $10^5$ M$_{\odot}$. Combined with lens-galaxy characterisation from the European Extremely Large Telescope (ELT), which strengthens the physical interpretation of detected perturbers, and the unprecedented lens samples expected from Euclid and the Square Kilometre Array (SKA), this facility could deliver a census of low-mass dark matter haloes and wandering massive black holes across cosmic time.

title: Strong gravitational lensing with Euclid
comment: Contribution to the Focus Point ''Surprises from major new telescopes''
summary: Euclid data is going to lead to the discovery of approximately 10^5 new strong gravitational lenses, thereby increasing the number of known lenses by a factor of 30. Such an impressive jump has the potential to revolutionise the field of strong lensing, by covering an ever-increasing range in the parameter space occupied by the lenses and lensed sources, and by uncovering rare and precious strong lens systems. The first quick data release of Euclid has already revealed hundreds of lenses, giving us a taste of what the final Euclid strong lens sample might look like. These lenses include a variety of objects acting as deflectors, from isolated galaxies to clusters, from early-type galaxies to edge-on disks. As many as four double-source plane lenses, in which one foreground object lenses two galaxies at two different redshifts, have already been discovered. As more data are acquired, it might become possible to detect the strong lensing signature of dwarf galaxy satellites, and to find lenses with an unusually large number of images. In this paper, we try to anticipate the kind of discoveries that these data will bring along.

title: Microcaustics: Fast GPU-Accelerated Dynamical Microlensing of Time-Dependent Extended Sources
comment: 26 pages, 11 figures. Code available at https://github.com/JFagin/microcaustics
summary: Gravitational microlensing probes unresolved quasar accretion disc structure and compact objects in lens galaxies and is an important systematic in strong-lens time-delay cosmography. Most analyses use static microlensing map simulations because evolving individual microlenses and caustics is computationally prohibitive. We present Microcaustics, a GPU-accelerated Python package built on PyTorch for dynamical microlensing of time-dependent extended sources in strong gravitational lenses. It combines a local-exact/far-field deflection solver, source-directed lens-plane scouting with temporal reuse, and biquadratic inverse polygon mapping (IPM). GPU batching and fused Triton rasterization accelerate the calculation, while binary caustic labels track source-centred crossings. Across three simulated quadruply lensed quasar systems, our package generates a 10-year, 147-frame multiband light curve in an amortized median of 0.68 s (0.88 s with labels) on a consumer GPU with a median light-curve RMSE of 0.35 mmag, while recovering every reference source-centred caustic crossing. At comparable map accuracy, the batched throughput is 780 times higher than that of a recent CUDA IPM implementation and extrapolates to a speedup of millions relative to classic GPU-D. We demonstrate that our IPM converges as $N_{\rm ray}^{-0.84}$, approaching the idealized $N_{\rm ray}^{-1}$ convergence rate of piecewise-affine IPM and improving upon the $N_{\rm ray}^{-1/2}$ inverse ray-shooting rate. We also introduce a GPU-resident general relativistic and reverberating quasar source model and demonstrate our method with an evolving supernova source. These advances make fully dynamical stellar fields practical for Bayesian and simulation-based inference.

AI.tldr: Microcaustics：一个基于 PyTorch 的 GPU 加速 Python 软件包，实现强引力透镜中时变延展源的动态微透镜模拟，可在消费级 GPU 上高效生成含微焦散交叉的多波段光变曲线。
AI.motivation: 引力微透镜可探测类星体吸积盘结构与透镜星系中的致密天体，是强透镜时延宇宙学的重要系统误差来源。但多数分析使用静态微透镜图模拟，因为演化单个微透镜和焦散的计算代价过高，难以实用。
AI.method: 提出 Microcaustics 软件包，基于 PyTorch 与 GPU 加速。方法整合了局部精确/远场偏转求解器、带时间复用的源导向透镜平面探测，以及双二次反多边形映射（IPM）；利用 GPU 批处理与融合 Triton 光栅化加速计算，并用二元焦散标签追踪以源为中心的交叉，同时引入 GPU 常驻的广义相对论与混响类星体源模型。
AI.result: 在三个模拟的四重透镜类星体系统上，软件包生成 10 年、147 帧多波段光变曲线，消费级 GPU 上摊销中位耗时 0.68 s（含标签 0.88 s），光变曲线 RMSE 中位为 0.35 mmag，并能恢复全部参考源中心焦散交叉。相同图精度下，批处理吞吐量比近期 CUDA IPM 实现高 780 倍，相对经典 GPU-D 外推可达百万倍加速。IPM 收敛率为 N_ray^-0.84，接近分段仿射 IPM 的理想 N_ray^-1，优于逆向光线射击的 N_ray^-1/2。
AI.conclusion: 这些进展使完全动态的恒星场模拟在贝叶斯和基于模拟的推断中变得实用，并以演化超新星源演示了方法的通用性。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 引力微引力透镜探测未分辨的类星体吸积盘结构以及透镜星系中的致密天体，并且是强透镜时间延迟宇宙学中的一个重要系统误差来源。大多数分析使用静态微引力透镜图模拟，因为演化单个微引力透镜和焦散在计算上代价过高。我们提出了 Microcaustics，一个基于 PyTorch 构建的 GPU 加速 Python 包，用于强引力透镜中时变延展源的动态微引力透镜。它结合了局部精确/远场偏转求解器、带时间复用的源导向透镜平面搜索以及双二次逆多边形映射（IPM）。GPU 批处理和融合 Triton 光栅化加速了计算，而二元焦散标签跟踪以源为中心的穿越。在三个模拟的四重透镜类星体系统中，我们的包在消费级 GPU 上以摊销中位数 0.68 秒（带标签为 0.88 秒）生成 10 年、147 帧的多波段光变曲线，光变曲线 RMSE 中位数为 0.35 mmag，同时恢复每个参考的以源为中心的焦散穿越。在可比的图精度下，批处理吞吐量比最近的 CUDA IPM 实现高 780 倍，并外推至相对于经典 GPU-D 的数百万倍加速。我们证明我们的 IPM 收敛为 $N_{\rm ray}^{-0.84}$，接近分段仿射 IPM 的理想化 $N_{\rm ray}^{-1}$ 收敛率，并改进了 $N_{\rm ray}^{-1/2}$ 逆射线射击率。我们还引入了一个 GPU 驻留的广义相对论和混响类星体源模型，并用一个演化的超新星源演示了我们的方法。这些进展使完全动态的恒星场在贝叶斯和基于模拟的推断中变得实用。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 这些进展使完全动态的恒星场模拟在贝叶斯和基于模拟的推断中变得实用，并以演化超新星源演示了方法的通用性。（基于可用摘要）

Here, the scouting retains only \(0.26\%\) of the full-field cells. The inset shows its four fine-grid vertices and their mapped positions. Right: a selected fine cell is evaluated on the \((r+1)\times(r+1)\) lattice of true ray-traced nodes. title: Cosmology with strong gravitational lenses
comment: Reviews of Modern Physics, invited article; 59 pages, 32 figures
summary: Three of the most pressing open questions in cosmology -- the nature of dark energy and dark matter, and the growing tension in the value of the Hubble constant H$_0$ -- call for cosmological probes that are independent of, and complementary to, traditional methods. Strong gravitational lensing offers exactly that: a purely gravitational probe of the universe's expansion history and matter distribution, sensitive to dark matter's presence regardless of whether it interacts with light. Time-delay lenses and multiplane lenses can measure H$_0$ and the dark energy equation of state directly, while the distortion of lensed images can reveal the abundance and internal structure of dark matter subhalos. After a brief theoretical and historical introduction, I review recent breakthroughs enabled by JWST and by advances in lens modeling and stellar dynamics. Examples include the recent measurement of H$_0$ with 3\% precision in flat $Λ$ cold dark matter cosmology, and a tentative detection of dark matter self-interaction. Strong lensing is entering a pivotal era: wide-field surveys with Euclid, Rubin, and Roman, and radio surveys with the Square Kilometer Array, are poised to increase the number of known strong lenses by orders of magnitude, positioning strong lensing to play a central role in answering these open questions in the decade ahead.

title: What fuels the growth of stars and black holes in galaxies through cosmic time? The physics and chemistry of the interstellar medium in distant galaxies
comment: Part of the ALMA2040 White Paper Series. 9 pages 3 figures
summary: The interplay between the baryonic matter in galaxies (gas, dust, stars) has a fundamental role in our understanding of galaxy formation and evolution through cosmic time. The (sub)mm regime provides a unique window to measure the physical conditions and chemistry in the cold and dusty gas reservoirs that fuel the formation of new stars and the growth of massive black holes in distant galaxies. Large sub(mm) interferometers have made a revolutionary impact mapping the cold gas and dust in galaxies beyond the local universe. However, significant progress is hampered by limited spectral-line sensitivity. After more than a decade of surveys, molecular gas (traced by 12CO) has been measured only in a few tens of typical, massive main-sequence star-forming galaxies at z>1, while access to fainter gas-tracing species has been limited to only the very brightest galaxies. Thereby it restricts access to the detailed conditions in the cold gas clouds in typical galaxies in the distant universe. A revolutionary, flagship sub-mm interferometer with a massive increase in instantaneous spectral line sensitivity and broad spectral grasp (ALMA2040) fills this gap by enabling rich, multi-transition, multi-species and multi-isotopologue studies of the atomic and molecular interstellar medium for thousands of typical galaxies across galaxy populations and redshift. This will unveil how the ISM evolves across the galaxy population for statistical samples in different redshift bins, detailed studies of the physical conditions and chemistry in the multi-phase interstellar medium of typical galaxies, and how the cold ISM regulates and responds to star- and black-hole formation, providing a tremendous leap forward in the study of galaxy assembly over cosmic time.

AI.tldr: 提出ALMA2040旗舰亚毫米波干涉仪，通过大幅提升瞬时谱线灵敏度和宽频覆盖，实现对遥远宇宙中大量典型星系冷气体与尘埃的多跃迁、多物种、多同位素研究。
AI.motivation: 星系中重子物质（气体、尘埃、恒星）的相互作用对理解星系形成与演化至关重要。亚毫米波段是探测冷尘埃气体储库的独特窗口，但现有大型干涉仪受限于谱线灵敏度：十余年巡天后，z>1的典型大质量主序星系中仅数十个测得12CO分子气体，更暗弱的示踪物种仅在最亮星系中可及，限制了对遥远宇宙典型星系冷气体云详细条件的认知。

AI.conclusion: ALMA2040将填补现有观测空白，在宇宙时间尺度上星系组装研究中实现巨大飞跃。

title: Probing ordered magnetic fields in galaxies across cosmic time
comment: Part of the ALMA2040 White Paper Series, 10 pages, 3 figures, additional comments are welcome
summary: Magnetic fields are dynamically important across many astronomical environments, yet their origin, strength, and evolution over cosmic time remain poorly understood. Ordered magnetic fields are ubiquitous in the nearby Universe, as revealed by a range of observational techniques, but evidence for their existence at cosmological distances is scarce. Recent ALMA detections of polarised dust emission indicate that galactic-scale ordered magnetic fields, spanning up to kiloparsec scales, were already present in massive star-forming galaxies at redshifts up to $z\sim5.6$. This white paper argues that the ALMA2040 concept -- with its nearly tenfold improvement in sensitivity and angular resolution, and full-polarisation capability extended to higher-frequency bands -- will open up the study of cosmic magnetism in the early Universe. We identify four science drivers: constraining the dynamos that generate galactic-scale ordered fields, measuring the strength of early magnetic fields, connecting magnetic fields to galaxy evolution across cosmic time, and constraining dust grain properties through the polarised spectral energy distribution. We summarise the corresponding requirements in angular resolution, spectral coverage, and sensitivity, and discuss synergies with next-generation telescopes.

title: Sleeping or Dead? Probing the Quenching Mechanism of JWST Dormant Galaxies at z > 3 with ALMA
comment: 19 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables (including Appendix), submitted to Astronomy & Astrophysics
summary: JWST has revealed a population of "dormant'' galaxies at z>3 with strong Balmer breaks and weak emission lines, whose star formation appears to have declined only recently. Whether these galaxies are undergoing a lasting transition toward quiescence or merely experiencing a temporary suppression of star formation remains unclear. We investigate their molecular gas content using archival ALMA observations of [CII]158um and CO rotational transitions. Starting from all publicly available JWST/NIRSpec prism observations and using joint spectrophotometric fitting, we construct a parent sample at z>3 and log(Mstar/Msun)>9.5 in the ALMA-accessible COSMOS, UDS, and GOODS-South fields. Our final sample comprises 7 dormant galaxies and 15 quiescent galaxies with ALMA constraints on their molecular gas content (mostly 3 sigma upper limits). We find that dormant galaxies exhibit systematically lower star formation rates averaged over the past 10Myr (SFR10Myr) than over the past 100Myr (SFR100Myr), supporting a recent rapid decline in their star formation. For the ~70% of the sample with sufficiently constraining ALMA observations, their molecular gas fractions lie at least ~0.3-2dex below those expected for main-sequence galaxies. Moreover, the molecular gas fractions of dormant galaxies show no systematic difference from those of quiescent galaxies in our sample. This indicates that dormant galaxies have already reached a gas-poor state shortly after quenching and favors a scenario in which the rapid shutdown of star formation is associated with depletion or removal of the molecular gas reservoir, rather than primarily with suppressed star formation efficiency while retaining a substantial molecular gas reservoir. Our results suggest that, if no substantial gas replenishment occurs in the future, dormant galaxies are more consistent with becoming "dead'' than with being temporarily "sleeping''.

artifacts.abstract_zh: JWST揭示了一群在z>3处具有强巴尔末突变和弱发射线的“休眠”星系，其恒星形成似乎仅在最近才下降。这些星系是正在经历向静止的持久转变，还是仅仅经历恒星形成的暂时抑制，目前尚不清楚。我们利用档案ALMA对[CII]158um和CO转动跃迁的观测来研究它们的分子气体含量。从所有公开可用的JWST/NIRSpec棱镜观测出发，并使用联合分光光度拟合，我们在ALMA可及的COSMOS、UDS和GOODS-South天区构建了z>3且log(Mstar/Msun)>9.5的母样本。我们的最终样本包括7个休眠星系和15个静止星系，并具有ALMA对其分子气体含量的限制（大多为3 sigma上限）。我们发现，休眠星系在过去10Myr平均的恒星形成率（SFR10Myr）系统性地低于过去100Myr平均的恒星形成率（SFR100Myr），支持其恒星形成最近快速下降。对于样本中约70%具有足够限制性ALMA观测的星系，其分子气体分数至少比主序星系预期值低约0.3-2dex。此外，休眠星系的分子气体分数与样本中静止星系相比没有系统性差异。这表明休眠星系在淬灭后不久已达到气体贫乏状态，并支持一种情景：恒星形成的快速关闭与分子气体储库的耗竭或移除相关，而非主要与在保留大量分子气体储库的情况下抑制恒星形成效率有关。我们的结果表明，如果未来没有大量气体补充，休眠星系更倾向于成为“死亡”星系，而非暂时“沉睡”。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用的摘要，休眠星系在淬灭后不久已达气体贫乏状态，支持其恒星形成快速关闭与分子气体储库的耗竭或移除相关，而非主要源于气体存在下恒星形成效率被抑制。若无实质性气体补充，休眠星系更倾向于走向“死亡”而非暂时“沉睡”。

title: Hot Molecular Hydrogen in Galaxies at Redshift ~ 0.2-1.5 Revealed by JWST
summary: Molecular hydrogen (H$_2$) is the fundamental component of the molecular gas reservoir that fuels star formation and black hole growth. While prominent hot H$_2$ emission ($\gtrsim 1000$ K) has been explored in nearby galaxies, its excitation mechanisms at higher redshifts remain poorly constrained. We present a systematic study of hot molecular gas traced via ro-vibrational H$_2$ emitters at z~0.2-1.5 using JWST slitless spectroscopy. Exploiting JWST's great sensitivity to near-infrared H$_2$ ro-vibrational transitions such as H$_2$ 1-0 S(1), we build a sample of 144 H$_2$-luminous galaxies and characterize their multi-wavelength properties. About 96.5% and 80% of these galaxies are detected in the radio and far-infrared (FIR) bands, respectively, and their hot H$_2$ emission strongly correlates with the radio and FIR radiation. Based on radio excess, X-ray emission, and optical diagnostics, 62 sources (43%) exhibit significant AGN activity. The H$_2$ line luminosities of the sample show a sublinear dependence on radio luminosity, while the relation between the H$_2$ luminosities and total infrared luminosities is approximately linear after excluding the radio-excess sources. These scaling relations suggest that star formation provides a baseline contribution to hot H$_2$ excitation, while radio-excess sources require an additional contribution from AGN-related processes such as jet- or wind-driven shocks. These results reveal a multi-channel excitation scenario and shed new light on the interplay between star formation, AGN activity, and the interstellar medium during galaxy evolution.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 分子氢（H$_2$）是分子气体储库的基本组成部分，为恒星形成和黑洞生长提供燃料。虽然在近邻星系中已经探索到显著的热H$_2$发射（$\gtrsim 1000$ K），但其在更高红移处的激发机制仍然约束不足。我们利用JWST无缝光谱对z~0.2-1.5处通过振转H$_2$发射体示踪的热分子气体进行了系统研究。利用JWST对近红外H$_2$振转跃迁（如H$_2$ 1-0 S(1)）的高灵敏度，我们构建了144个H$_2$亮星系的样本，并表征了它们的多波段性质。这些星系中约96.5%和80%分别在射电和远红外（FIR）波段被探测到，其热H$_2$发射与射电和FIR辐射强烈相关。基于射电过量、X射线发射和光学诊断，62个源（43%）表现出显著的AGN活动。样本的H$_2$线光度对射电光度呈现亚线性依赖，而在排除射电过量源后，H$_2$光度与总红外光度之间的关系近似线性。这些标度关系表明，恒星形成为热H$_2$激发提供了基线贡献，而射电过量源则需要AGN相关过程（如喷流或风驱动激波）的额外贡献。这些结果揭示了一个多通道激发情景，并为星系演化过程中恒星形成、AGN活动和星际介质之间的相互作用提供了新的见解。

title: Unveiling the Baryon Cycle Through Cosmic Time
comment: Part of the ALMA2040 White Paper Series. 11 pages, 4 figures, 1 table
summary: Galaxy evolution is governed by the baryon cycle: gas accreted from the cosmic web and circumgalactic medium condenses into molecular gas, forms stars, and is redistributed by stellar and AGN feedback. Tracing the molecular phase is therefore essential to understanding how galaxies acquire, consume, and eject their baryons. Yet current molecular-gas surveys remain limited by sensitivity, area, cosmic variance, and spectral bandwidth. ALMA2040 would combine a $\sim10\times$ sensitivity improvement with $\gtrsim512$ GHz simultaneous frequency coverage, delivering $\sim100\times$ faster mapping at fixed depth and a further $\gtrsim25\times$ gain in instantaneous bandwidth. Together, these advances would increase spectroscopic survey speed by orders of magnitude, enabling tiered ``wedding-cake'' strategies: an ultra-deep $\sim4$-5 arcmin$^2$ field probing faint and high-redshift reservoirs, a $\sim$0.25 deg$^2$ survey reaching molecular-line sensitivities comparable to current ultra-deep fields over a much larger cosmological volume, and thousands of independent pointings minimizing cosmic variance. Broad spectral coverage would simultaneously detect multiple CO transitions, [CI], H$_2$O, feedback tracers, far-IR fine-structure lines, and dust continuum, constraining molecular gas, ISM conditions, obscured star formation, and gas flows within the same observations. Every targeted observation would also become a molecular deep field, extending these measurements to serendipitous galaxies. Together with future HI, optical, and near-IR surveys, ALMA2040 would enable a population-resolved view of the baryon cycle across cosmic time and stringent tests of galaxy formation models.

title: The dawn of the first galaxies
comment: Part of the ALMA2040 White Paper Series
summary: Understanding how the first galaxies assembled their stellar mass at cosmic dawn is a central frontier of modern astrophysics. JWST has now revealed an unexpected population of ultraviolet-bright galaxies at z>10, whose intense emission points towards a rapid stellar mass growth that challenges current models of early galaxy assembly. Yet, the cold gas fueling this growth remains hidden: current ALMA sensitivity restricts routine detection to only the brightest ionized-gas tracers such as [OIII] 88$μ$m, while [CII] 158$μ$m, a key coolant and gas-mass proxy of the neutral interstellar medium (ISM), is undetected beyond $z\sim8$. This leaves fundamental questions unanswered: how quickly primeval galaxies gathered cold gas and turned it into stars; what physical conditions (density, temperature, radiation field) characterized their ISM; how fast metals and dust built up; and how feedback regulated early gas assembly. Only a transformational sub-millimeter facility like ALMA2040 can address these questions, enabling systematic surveys of [CII] in the first galaxies and providing a representative census of gas fractions and depletion times. A simulated galaxy at $z=11.3$ shows that ALMA2040 not only will detect, but also spatially resolve its merging cold-gas structure in [CII] on $\sim$200 pc scales in 5 hours (below 100 pc in 10 hours). ALMA2040 will also spectrally resolve multiple lines simultaneously, akin to integral-field spectroscopy, providing the key diagnostics needed to break density-metallicity-radiation-field degeneracies and map the multi-phase ISM of z>10 galaxies. The combination of dramatically increased line sensitivity and wide instantaneous bandwidth will push the search for the first galaxies out to the earliest cosmic times, with [OIII] detectable up to $z\sim20$. ALMA2040 will thus be transformative for understanding how the first galaxies assembled at cosmic dawn.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 理解首批星系如何在宇宙黎明时期聚集其恒星质量是现代天体物理学的一个核心前沿。JWST 现已揭示了一个出乎意料的紫外明亮星系群体，位于 z>10，其强烈辐射指向快速的恒星质量增长，这挑战了当前早期星系组装模型。然而，驱动这一增长的冷气体仍然隐藏：当前 ALMA 灵敏度将常规探测限制在仅最明亮的电离气体示踪物，如 [OIII] 88$μ$m，而 [CII] 158$μ$m，作为中性星际介质（ISM）的关键冷却剂和气体质量代理，在 $z\sim8$ 之外未被探测到。这留下了基本问题未解答：原始星系多快聚集冷气体并将其转化为恒星；什么物理条件（密度、温度、辐射场）表征了它们的 ISM；金属和尘埃积累多快；以及反馈如何调节早期气体组装。只有像 ALMA2040 这样的变革性亚毫米设施才能解决这些问题，使得能够系统巡天首批星系中的 [CII]，并提供气体分数和耗尽时间的代表性普查。一个 $z=11.3$ 的模拟星系显示，ALMA2040 不仅将探测到，而且将在 5 小时内以 $\sim$200 pc 尺度空间分辨其合并冷气体结构在 [CII] 中（10 小时内低于 100 pc）。ALMA2040 还将同时光谱分辨多条谱线，类似于积分场光谱，提供打破密度-金属丰度-辐射场简并和映射 z>10 星系多相 ISM 所需的关键诊断。显著增加的谱线灵敏度和宽瞬时带宽的结合将把首批星系的搜寻推进到最早的宇宙时代，[OIII] 可探测到 $z\sim20$。因此，ALMA2040 将对理解首批星系如何在宇宙黎明时期组装具有变革性意义。

title: The Role of Environment in Shaping the Assembly Timelines of Massive Quiescent Galaxies at Cosmic Noon
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Resubmitted to MNRAS after moderate revision
summary: JWST observations of massive quiescent galaxies (MQGs) at $z\sim2$ have revealed diverse star formation histories (SFHs). In this letter, we investigate whether these variations are linked to the environment in which MQGs reside, as quantified by the host dark matter halo mass. We identify 12 MQGs from a representative sample of galaxies at $1.6<z<3.5$ obtained by the Blue Jay survey, a JWST Cycle 1 program, and infer their SFHs via modelling of the deep NIRSpec medium-resolution spectra along with multi-band photometry. By correlating the formation and quenching epochs of individual MQGs with their respective host halo masses from the 3D-HST survey, we find that after accounting for the redshift range of the sample ($1.8<z<2.5$), MQGs in more massive haloes formed at significantly earlier cosmic epochs. Meanwhile, although these galaxies also quenched earlier overall, the scatter in quenching epochs across similar halo masses indicates that the quenching process likely involves other contributing factors and is not solely determined by halo mass.

title: Large-scale Environmental Dependence of AGN Activity Revealed by JWST Pa$α$ Emitters
summary: The role of the large-scale environment in regulating AGN activity remains an open question. We investigate the Mpc-scale environments of 70 AGNs at $z=1.1$-$1.5$ using a highly complete sample of 3,419 Pa$α$ emitters with accurate spectroscopic redshifts from JWST slitless spectroscopic survey. This dataset allows us to robustly trace the environments and quantify the environmental dependence of AGN properties. We measure the eighth-nearest-neighbor surface density of Pa$α$ emitters around each AGN, probing $\sim$1.5 pMpc scale environments. We find that this environmental density exhibits a weak positive correlation with radio luminosity. Radio-bright AGNs tend to reside in statistically denser environments than their radio-faint counterparts. The environmental density also has a positive correlation with the Eddington ratio and a weak negative correlation with the central black hole mass, implying more efficient black hole accretion in dense environments. We construct Pa$α$ luminosity functions (LFs) in AGN environments and find that they are systematically elevated relative to the field Pa$α$ LF. In addition, their faint-end slopes are shallower, suggesting accelerated galaxy growth and enhanced quenching of star formation. As Pa$α$ emitters trace gas-rich, star-forming galaxies, our results support a scenario in which the large-scale cold gas promotes AGN activity at cosmic noon.

AI.tldr: 利用JWST对70个AGN周围Mpc尺度环境的研究表明，大尺度冷气体环境促进宇宙正午时期的AGN活动。
AI.motivation: 大尺度环境在调节AGN活动中所起的作用仍是一个悬而未决的问题，需要更完整、更精确的样本加以探究。
AI.method: 基于JWST无缝光谱巡天，构建了包含3,419个具有精确光谱红移的Paα发射体高完备样本，测量每个AGN周围Paα发射体的第八近邻表面密度（对应~1.5 pMpc尺度），并构建AGN环境中的Paα光度函数。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 大尺度环境在调控AGN活动中的作用仍是一个未解之谜。我们利用JWST无缝光谱巡天中一个高度完备的样本，包含3,419个具有精确光谱红移的Pa$\alpha$发射体，研究了70个位于$z=1.1$-$1.5$的AGN的Mpc尺度环境。该数据集使我们能够稳健地追踪环境并量化AGN性质的环境依赖性。我们测量了每个AGN周围Pa$\alpha$发射体的第八近邻表面密度，探测了$\sim$1.5 pMpc尺度的环境。我们发现该环境密度与射电光度呈现弱正相关。射电明亮的AGN倾向于比射电暗弱的对应体居住在统计上更致密的环境中。环境密度也与爱丁顿比呈正相关，与中心黑洞质量呈弱负相关，暗示在致密环境中黑洞吸积更有效。我们构建了AGN环境中的Pa$\alpha$光度函数（LFs），发现它们相对于场Pa$\alpha$光度函数系统性地升高。此外，它们的暗端斜率更平缓，表明星系生长加速和恒星形成淬灭增强。由于Pa$\alpha$发射体追踪富气体、恒星形成星系，我们的结果支持大尺度冷气体促进宇宙正午时期AGN活动的图景。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用的摘要：由于Paα发射体追踪富气体、恒星形成星系，结果支持大尺度冷气体促进宇宙正午时期AGN活动的图景。

title: JWST lensed quasar dark matter survey V: Hints of self-interacting dark matter from 29 quadruply imaged quasars
summary: Theories of self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) predict the eventual core collapse of dark matter halos, a process that transforms these structures into extremely efficient gravitational lenses. We present a population-level inference on the abundance of core collapsed halos and subhalos in the mass range $10^6 - 10^{10.7} M_{\odot}$ using 29 quadruply imaged quasars, drawing on the collective lensing signal of many low-mass perturbers. Our structure formation model predicts the abundance of collapsed (sub)halos as a function of halo mass and redshift. We quantify how our results are affected by systematic uncertainties, including the abundance of globular clusters (GCs) and subhalos, and the internal structure of deeply collapsed halos. Our data exhibits a strong preference for core collapsed halos in the lens model, with Bayes factors disfavoring CDM relative to SIDM ranging from 8:1 to 24:1, depending on the assumed SIDM subhalo abundance and the internal structure of collapsed halos. Explaining our data without core collapse requires both a GC abundance well above expectations and more subhalos than predicted by $N$-body simulations. These results pose a challenge to the CDM paradigm. We present a particle physics interpretation of these results in a companion paper.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 自相互作用暗物质（SIDM）理论预测暗物质晕最终会发生核心坍缩，这一过程将这些结构转变为极其高效的引力透镜。我们利用29个四重成像类星体，对质量范围在 $10^6 - 10^{10.7} M_{\odot}$ 内的核心坍缩晕和子晕的丰度进行了群体级别的推断，利用了众多低质量扰动体的集体透镜信号。我们的结构形成模型预测了坍缩（子）晕丰度作为晕质量和红移的函数。我们量化了系统不确定性对我们结果的影响，包括球状星团（GCs）和子晕的丰度，以及深度坍缩晕的内部结构。我们的数据在透镜模型中强烈偏好核心坍缩晕，相对于CDM，SIDM的贝叶斯因子从8:1到24:1不等，取决于假设的SIDM子晕丰度和坍缩晕的内部结构。要在没有核心坍缩的情况下解释我们的数据，需要球状星团丰度远高于预期，并且子晕数量多于 $N$-体模拟的预测。这些结果对CDM范式提出了挑战。我们在姊妹论文中给出了这些结果的粒子物理解释。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：结果对CDM范式构成挑战，并为SIDM提供了支持；粒子物理解释见姊妹论文。

title: A Vision for Little Red Dots in the Low-Redshift Universe with ALMA2040
comment: Part of the ALMA2040 White Paper Series. 8 pages, 2 figures
summary: The discovery of Little Red Dots (LRDs) at high redshifts with JWST has revealed a previously unknown phase of black-hole growth. However, their black-hole (BH) masses, BH-to-stellar mass ratios, cold-gas reservoirs, and depletion times remain uncertain. The recent discovery of low-redshift LRDs at $z\simeq0.1 - 0.9$ creates a decisive opportunity to access their low-$J$ CO lines for measuring molecular gas reservoirs, and the nearest systems can in principle be spatially resolved. We use J1025+1402 ("The Egg") at $z=0.1007$, the best-studied local LRD, as a benchmark to explore the scientific opportunities with ALMA2040. Assuming a molecular gas mass of $10^9\,M_\odot$, the CO(2-1) detectability strongly depends on the assumed CO-to-H$_2$ conversion ($α_{\rm CO}$). With a large $α_{\rm CO} \simeq 315 - 725\,M_\odot\,({\rm K\,km\,s}^{-1}\,{\rm pc}^2)^{-1}$ at a low gas-phase metallicity, the CO line would remain very challenging for the current ALMA to detect, while ALMA2040 will likely deliver a robust CO detection and thus a gas-reservoir constraint for The Egg. Furthermore, with the best angular resolution at its CO(2-1) frequency (14.6 mas, or 27 pc), ALMA2040 may spatially resolve the CO emission from The Egg. Assuming an optimistic, SMC-like $α_{\rm CO}$ with a 50-hour deep integration, we produce mock position-velocity diagrams that may distinguish a $10^7\,M_\odot$ black hole from the no-BH model through its steeper central velocity structure. We conclude that ALMA2040 has the potential to directly measure the gas masses, depletion times, and excitation of local LRDs, while the CO-bright subset may ultimately yield dynamical constraints on the mass of their central black holes.

title: How much can shape degeneracies affect the Hubble constant measurement?
summary: Cluster lens models are constrained almost entirely by observed lensed image positions, leaving a large space of mass perturbations with arbitrary amplitudes such that they reproduce every image exactly. Such degeneracies are known as shape degeneracies (ShaDes). We show that these ShaDes shift the observed time delays, by the difference of the perturbing potential between the two images, without depending on the number of source/lens planes. Bounding their amplitude by preserving the positivity of the convergence, image multiplicity, and parity, in MACS J0138.0$-$2155, they can contribute at least $\simeq7$ days to the delay between the detected images of SN-Encore (i.e., $17.5\%$ of the measured value of $39.8$ days) and $\simeq112$ days (i.e., $2.8$--$3.7\%$ of predicted value of $3,000-4000$ days) to the reappearance intervals predicted for SN-Encore and SN-Requiem. These error bars transfer one-to-one to $H_0$, and remain invisible in comparisons of independent models.

title: The stellar-to-halo mass relation of central galaxies across three orders of halo mass
summary: The stellar content of galaxies is tightly connected to the mass and growth of their host dark matter halos. Observational constraints on this relation remain limited, particularly for low-mass groups, leaving uncertainties in how galaxies assemble their stars across halo mass scales. Accurately measuring the brightest central galaxy (BCG) stellar-to-halo mass relation (SHMR) over a wide mass range is therefore crucial for understanding galaxy formation and the role of feedback processes. Here we present the SHMR spanning $M_{\rm halo} \sim 10^{12}$-$10^{15}\,M_\odot$, using halo masses derived from eROSITA eRASS1 X-ray data and BCG stellar masses based on SDSS photometry. By stacking X-ray spectra of optically selected groups, we recover robust average halo gas temperatures for each bin, which are then converted to halo masses via the $M$-$T_X$ relation. We find that the SHMR peaks near $M_{\rm halo} \sim 10^{12}\,M_\odot$, with a declining stellar fraction at higher masses. This trend reflects a combination of processes that reduce the efficiency of stellar mass growth in massive halos, such as AGN feedback, reduced cooling efficiency, and the increasing dominance of ex-situ assembly, while halos continue to grow through mergers and accretion. Our measurements are consistent over the full mass range with previous observational studies, including weak lensing, X-ray analyses of individual clusters, and kinematical and dynamical methods. Comparisons with hydrodynamical simulations show good agreement at low masses but reveal significant discrepancies in the normalization at cluster scales, highlighting the sensitivity of BCG stellar growth to feedback prescriptions and halo assembly history. These results provide the first X-ray-based observational SHMR covering three orders of magnitude in halo mass, establish a robust benchmark for testing galaxy formation models.

title: A Search for Dust in the Outflow of the HH212 Class 0 Protostellar System
comment: 25 pages, 9 figures. Accepted for publication in AJ
summary: Perhaps the most visually striking phenomenon during star formation is the ejection of material along the direction of the protostar's rotational axis. Observed in the form of molecular outflows and/or atomic jets, these features carry away mass, energy and angular momentum from the system. Given the known dust content of protoplanetary disks, and the energetics of outflows, it has been suggested that it should be possible to lift dust from disks via winds, yet limited observational evidence has been presented in the literature. Any detection of dust within protostellar outflows not only puts constraints on the dust content in outflows, but if a sufficient amount of dust can be removed from the system, the mass budget for planet formation could also be affected. We present re-imaging of archival, multi-frequency dust continuum observations taken with the Atacama Large Millimeter/sub-millimeter Array (ALMA) towards the HH212 protostellar system. We detect an extension in the dust emission, and using multi-frequency data in Bands 7 and 9, we estimate the spectral index of the emitting dust and the dust mass in the wind launching region. We find a small but still significant amount of dust mass coincident with the molecular outflow cavity. This finding is assessed in relation to the hypothesis that the outflow could be capable of transporting dust away from the HH212 protoplanetary disk.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 在恒星形成过程中，或许最引人注目的现象是物质沿原恒星旋转轴方向被抛射出去。这些以分子外流和/或原子喷流形式被观测到的特征，将质量、能量和角动量从系统中带走。鉴于已知的原行星盘尘埃含量以及外流的能量学，有研究提出，通过星风将尘埃从盘中扬起是可能的，然而文献中提供的观测证据有限。在原恒星外流中任何尘埃的探测，不仅对外流中的尘埃含量施加限制，而且如果能够从系统中移除足够数量的尘埃，行星形成的质量预算也可能受到影响。我们展示了利用阿塔卡马大型毫米/亚毫米波阵列（ALMA）对HH212原恒星系统进行的存档多频尘埃连续谱观测的重新成像。我们探测到尘埃发射的延伸，并利用Band 7和Band 9的多频数据，估算了发射尘埃的谱指数以及风发射区域中的尘埃质量。我们发现与分子外流腔体位置重合的少量但仍显著的尘埃质量。这一发现被用于评估外流能够将尘埃从HH212原行星盘中输运出去的假说。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 该发现被用于评估外流能够将尘埃从HH212原行星盘中输运出去的假说。

title: CoRGI in MaNGA - II. NGC 5717: cold-gas accretion and disk growth in a BGG
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables, submitted to A&A
summary: Large-scale stellar counter-rotation, in which two coplanar stellar components rotate in opposite directions, is usually interpreted as a signature of external gas accretion. Such systems are most often found in relatively sparse environments, where cold gas can be acquired and remain dynamically undisturbed long enough to settle into a disk. It is less clear whether this channel can operate in massive central galaxies, whose group or cluster environments can heat, strip, or perturb cold gas. Here we present NGC 5717, one of the most massive galaxies known to host a counter-rotating stellar disk and the first identified case in a brightest group galaxy. Using integral-field spectroscopy from SDSS-IV Mapping Nearby Galaxies at Apache Point Observatory (MaNGA), together with CFHT imaging, ancillary HI data, and SDSS/DESI spectroscopy of the surrounding group, we show that the galaxy contains a dynamically cold counter-rotating disk embedded in an old dynamically hot elliptical component. The disk is young ($\sim 1.3$ Gyr), metal-poor ([Fe/H] $\sim -0.7$ dex), extended ($h \sim 2.4$ kpc), and massive ($\log M_\star/M_\odot \sim 9.9$); the associated ionized gas co-rotates with it, while the available HI data indicate no significant remaining reservoir of neutral atomic gas ($\log M_{\mathrm{HI}}/M_\odot \lesssim 9$). These properties support an in situ origin of the secondary component from externally accreted gas. The chemical evolution model favors gas accretion from a cosmic filament, which is consistent with the surrounding cosmic-web geometry, and indicates highly efficient burst-like star formation with substantial metal-enriched outflows. NGC 5717 may therefore represent a rare example of disk growth in a massive central galaxy, enabled by external cold-gas accretion during an earlier phase of the group assembly history.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 大规模恒星反向旋转，即两个共面恒星组分沿相反方向旋转，通常被解释为外部气体吸积的特征。此类系统最常见于相对稀疏的环境中，在那里冷气体可以被获取并保持动力学上不受扰动足够长时间，从而沉降为盘。对于大质量中心星系，这一通道是否能够运作尚不清楚，因为其所在的群或星系团环境可能加热、剥离或扰动冷气体。本文中，我们展示了NGC 5717，它是已知宿主反向旋转恒星盘的最 massive 星系之一，也是最亮群星系中首个被确认的案例。利用SDSS-IV Mapping Nearby Galaxies at Apache Point Observatory (MaNGA)的积分场光谱，结合CFHT成像、辅助HI数据以及周围星系的SDSS/DESI光谱，我们表明该星系包含一个动力学冷反向旋转盘，嵌入在一个古老且动力学热的椭圆组分中。该盘年轻（$\sim 1.3$ Gyr）、贫金属（[Fe/H] $\sim -0.7$ dex）、延展（$h \sim 2.4$ kpc）且质量大（$\log M_\star/M_\odot \sim 9.9$）；相关的电离气体与其同向旋转，而现有HI数据表明没有显著剩余的中性原子气体储库（$\log M_{\mathrm{HI}}/M_\odot \lesssim 9$）。这些性质支持次级组分起源于外部吸积气体的原位形成。化学演化模型倾向于来自宇宙纤维状结构的气体吸积，这与周围的宇宙网几何一致，并表明存在高效爆发式恒星形成以及大量富金属外流。因此，NGC 5717可能代表大质量中心星系中盘增长的一个罕见例子，由群组装历史早期阶段的外部冷气体吸积所促成。

title: A Very Rich Bimodal Galaxy Cluster Merger: RXC J0032.1+1808
comment: This version, accepted to ApJ, substantially revises the LOS relative velocity inference and includes a new figure, but with little change to other conclusions. From arXiv v2 to v3 the only change is a metadata correction
summary: The galaxy cluster RXC J0032.1+1808 has been well-studied with optical imaging and gravitational lensing mass maps, both of which reveal an elongated morphology in the north-south direction. We find that its X-ray morphology is bimodal, suggesting that it is in the process of merging; combined with a previously reported detection of a radio relic, we suggest that the system is seen after first pericenter. We extract the global X-ray temperature and unabsorbed luminosity from archival XMM-Newton data, finding $T_X=8.5^{+1.1}_{-0.9}$ keV and $L_X=1.04 \pm 0.03 \times 10^{45}$ erg s$^{-1}$ at 90% confidence in the 0.5-10 keV energy range. We conduct a redshift survey of member galaxies and find that the line-of-sight relative velocity between the two subclusters is 1002-1785 km/s at 68% confidence, although the BCGs have an even larger difference of 2466 km/s. We use publicly available hydrodynamic simulations to show that it cannot be a head-on merger; it is consistent with an impact parameter of 0.5 or 1 Mpc. We also use the simulation set to find initial constraints on the time since pericenter (${\approx}$315-550 Myr) and the locus of possible lines of sight.

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: LOS likelihoods based on the kinematic observables \(\Delta v_{los}\) and \(d_{proj}\) . Top: for \(b=0.5\) . The middle timesteps are allowed by \(T_{X}\) , while those with gray titles are too hot or too cold by \({>}2\sigma\) but are shown for context. The two types of observables are complementary in the sense that they favor different but overlapping TSP ranges. The locus of allowed LOS is largely static because the orbit is nearly radial at these times. The separation vector points to \(\theta=90^{\circ}\) (by definition of the orbital plane) and \(\phi\approx 23^{\circ}\) (by happenstance). LOS \(\approx 30^{\circ}\) from there foreshorten that vector to match the observed \(d_{proj}\) while retaining a large fraction of the velocity along the LOS. Bottom: for \(b=1\) , which has coarser time sampling at the relevant times, and a separation vector that points to \(\phi\approx 45^{\circ}\) . The likelihood values are similar, indicating that either value of \(b\) produces viable models. The complementarity of X-ray and kinematic observables, and the stability of the allowed LOS locus, remain as noted for the \(b=0.5\) scenario.
